## Coverage & access
Datasource: `bdc-github` · private Grafana organization. These dashboards query GitHub directly; they do not create a historical metrics database or change Prometheus retention (5d). The time picker is a query filter, not deletion of GitHub history.

### Scope and freshness
- Only repositories visible to the PAT are included. Cross-check the inventory with a GitHub organization owner.
- GitHub search can cap results at 1,000. Narrow the window or repository when approaching that limit. Workflow inventory is limited to 100.
- Plugin cache can delay changes by about five minutes. Panels sharing a query use the same cached source response.
- Red query errors, 403, disabled features and no data must be investigated individually. They are not zero alerts.

### Management links
[Organization](https://github.com/Big-Data-Club) · [Projects](https://github.com/orgs/Big-Data-Club/projects) · [People](https://github.com/orgs/Big-Data-Club/people) · [Security](https://github.com/organizations/Big-Data-Club/settings/security_analysis)

### Not collected by this pack
Billing, audit events, team membership, organization-wide CI history, API quota telemetry and historical backlog snapshots need additional authorized endpoints or a collector. There are no fabricated charts for those metrics.
